episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Eunsoo seeks Sunwoo's help to write lyrics for a song which is requested by a famous composer.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Eunsoo and Sunwoo get awkward with the sudden touch, but they behave as though nothing had happened.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: While Eunsoo is in a daze after learning Sunwoo's thoughts, Sunwoo decides to admit his feelings.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Eunsoo feels void after Sunwoo leaves. She prepares to make her move as he returns to Korea.
